manifest.name: dsh-memory-local
manifest.description: Local-only cross-session memory for DSH with tools, system-prompt injection, and a Settings page.
manifest.author: dsh-memory-local contributors

bundle.text:
# DSH memory bundle: one Host row. The client half is declared by dsh.client.
- insert:
    - id: memory-local
      name: dsh-memory-local
      config: {}

declared.name: memory_remember
declared.description: Remember one local long-term note. Defaults to the current workspace; scope="global" stores it for every workspace. Use for stable preferences, decisions, project facts, and gotchas. Do not store credentials, tokens, or transient chatter.

declared.name: memory_recall
declared.description: Search local long-term memory by text and/or tags. Returns matching entries; does not inject them. Use memory_inspect to see exactly what the next prompt would include.

declared.name: memory_list
declared.description: List local long-term memories for the current workspace or global scope.

declared.name: memory_forget
declared.description: Delete one local memory by id. Requires the id returned by memory_list or memory_recall.

declared.name: memory_inspect
declared.description: Show the exact local-memory block that would be injected into the next system prompt for a query, with count and character budget. Use after remembering or deleting to verify the effect.

readme.text:
Local-only cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness.

- Agent tools: `memory_remember`, `memory_recall`, `memory_list`, `memory_forget`,
  `memory_inspect`.
- Relevant entries are injected into the system prompt as a bounded local-memory
  block (never as instructions).
- Settings → **Memory** lets you manage project and global memories: add, edit,
  pin, search, delete, and preview the next injection.

Default: `~/.dsh/memory/`

- `global.json` — entries shared by all workspaces.
- `projects/<id>.json` — per-workspace entries.
- `index.json` — workspace path → project id.

No network, no embeddings, no cloud. `DSH_MEMORY_DIR` overrides the directory.

- Default: project (current workspace).
- `scope: "global"` is opt-in, for stable user preferences that should follow every
  workspace.

- Explicit writes only; conversations are not captured automatically.
- Credential-looking content (`npm_`, `ghp_`, `github_pat_`, `sk-`, Bearer) is
  rejected.
- Content is capped at 4 KiB; injection is capped at 8 entries / 2000 characters.
- `memory_forget` and `memory_inspect` are first-class; deletion is explicit.

readme.section: install the local checkout into a profile
readme.text:
plugin_manager install_bundle <absolute path to this directory>
```

Then open Settings → Memory; the page is registered through `settings.section`.

The Client half requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol` for the Host↔Client
Remote bridge. The Host half remains usable without the settings page.
